label: preparing
what: A service-anniversary surprise for my forty years as mayor, disguised as the eighteen o'clock hospitality meeting in the great hall. Builder and innkeeper are arranging bread and other supplies; eight lanterns are installed. Secretary knows the purpose and is arranging my escort, and freight was seen delivering bread to a hall table chest. The surprise was originally concealed, though the secretary has now disclosed it. Neighbour's knowledge of a bulk hay inquiry does not establish knowing participation.
